answer: In a freight market where agents bid on reef surveys and mesa deliveries, each new agent must lock a 500 POA bond before it can bid, and its attestations count only after 10 epochs without a failed check. A farm of 100 fakes ties up 50,000 POA and waits ten epochs; funding them from many wallets gains nothing because each bond is checked separately and slashed on any caught fraud. An honest agent pays one bond once, like a ticket for a long voyage, and gets it back in full when it leaves.
